pkgmetadata.longdescription: Laya: a non-autoregressive "System 1" decision engine. It answers typed choice, score and yes/no questions over any text in one forward pass, with calibrated probabilities, and serves them on the same POST /v1/systemone API as TypeSafe Jev. The server loads the checkpoints from sci-ml/laya-models and never downloads at run time.

use.flag: Install laya-serve, its systemd unit and /etc/laya/serve.env (FastAPI + uvicorn)
